package.name: low_level_control_pkg
package.description: Low-level control subsystem for the Helios A4WD3 mecanum rover: owns the RoboClaw hardware connection outright (encoder reads + open-loop duty-cycle writes, roboclaw_driver_node) and joystick teleop (8BitDo SN30 Pro over Bluetooth) -> geometry_msgs/Twist (teleop_joy_node). Open-loop (duty, not closed-loop speed) until the RoboClaw's velocity PID/QPPS limits are calibrated.
